package main
import (
 "encoding/json"
 "fmt"
 "os"
 corev1 "k8s.io/api/core/v1"
 core "k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/apis/core"
 v1 "k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/apis/core/v1"
 "k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/apis/core/validation"
)
func main(){
 failed:=false
 for _,file:=range os.Args[1:] {
  b,err:=os.ReadFile(file);if err!=nil {panic(err)}
  var external corev1.Pod;if err=json.Unmarshal(b,&external);err!=nil{panic(err)}
  v1.SetObjectDefaults_Pod(&external)
  var pod core.Pod;if err=v1.Convert_v1_Pod_To_core_Pod(&external,&pod,nil);err!=nil{panic(err)}
  errs:=validation.ValidatePodCreate(&pod,validation.PodValidationOptions{})
  if len(errs)>0 {failed=true;fmt.Printf("FAIL %s: %v\n",file,errs)} else {fmt.Printf("PASS %s\n",file)}
 }
 if failed {os.Exit(1)}
}
